intro: Government and technology organisations across the United States and Europe have been the primary targets in nine articles between April and August 2026, with CISA’s Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue central to coverage. The most severe cases include CVE-2026-48907, rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2026-65400 at 9.8, and CVE-2026-42271 at 8.7. Additional high-severity flaws, CVE-2026-18556 and CVE-2026-18577, both scored 8.2, affected enterprise software. The reporting spans three critical, four high, and two medium severity vulnerabilities, with global reach concentrated in North America and the EU.
